title: Heilongjiang spring soybean / Heinong 84 literature candidate

TSUMEM.note: The paper prints degC; PCSE requires a temperature sum in degC day.

TSUM1.note: Medium-early is a regional prior selected from the official Heinong 84 classification, not a measured Heinong 84 parameter.

TSUM2.note: The table prints TMUS2=1150 and describes anthesis-to-maturity thermal time. This is mapped by meaning to native TSUM2. It is a Hailun regional prior; the study does not establish a Heinong 84 calibration.

IDSL.note: Temperature-only development is retained. No local photoperiod fit is claimed.

DTSMTB.note: Explicitly retain the bundled native response (approximately mean temperature minus 7 degC at common growing temperatures). Neither research table specifies native DTSMTB. Xu2026 Eq. 1 instead uses 8/37 degC for separately generated phenology maps; this candidate is not a reproduction of that complete setup.

scope.region: Heilongjiang spring-soybean systems; initial use in the existing Harbin HEINONG84 scenes
scope.cultivar_identity: HEINONG84 is the requested target, not the cultivar identity of every source experiment
scope.official_reference: The HAAS description reports 119 days from emergence to maturity; the 2025 MOA catalogue reports a mean 123 days and classifies Heinong 84 as northern spring soybean, medium-early maturity. These are external checks, not enforced engine dates.
scope.density: Existing realized-density to TDWI scaling remains unchanged; no density optimum is calibrated.
scope.soil: Scenario soil and root-zone depth remain unchanged; no Hailun soil values are substituted.
scope.management: Existing tools and maturity/harvest/storage gates remain authoritative. Fixed-date legacy harvest workflows may fail before native maturity.

model_transfer.method: Cross-study phenology prior only, combined before final-yield inspection. Not a published single cultivar parameterization or an independently calibrated local model.
model_transfer.retained: Native WOFOST 8.1 assimilation, N fixation and uptake, canopy, respiration, partitioning and rooting parameters from the pinned bundled soybean base.
excluded: No direct import of the WOFOST 7.2 AMAXTB table into the WOFOST 8.1 nitrogen-dependent assimilation module.
No import or silent correction of Sun2022 SLATB1=0.014; Xu2026 lists 0.00140 at DVS=0.00 and the conventions are not established as equivalent.
No conversion of 2400/2800/3500 degC active-temperature sums into TSUM1 or TSUM2 by direct assignment.
No multiplication of TWSO, forced maturity, yield-target fitting or harvest-gate bypass.

limitations: Cross-study transfer and simulation smoke tests do not establish predictive accuracy for Heinong 84.
Native temperature response and photoperiod remain assumptions needing local multi-year, multi-sowing-date observations.
Source studies do not supply a complete compatible WOFOST 8.1 nitrogen parameterization.
The original L3 weather is scenario-generated; agreement with a published average duration is a plausibility check, not independent field validation.
Normal and drought L3 scenes differ in weather and soil; their yield ordering alone is not a controlled drought-effect estimate.
